privileged_info_for_vlm: The target status label must be exactly 'Pending E-Waste' with the type 'Undeployable'. The EOL cutoff date is 2022-06-01; only laptops purchased before this date should be processed. Only assets in the 'Laptops' category should be affected. Replacement laptops must come from the 'Ready to Deploy' status pool and be assigned to the original users.
